fusions.name: Bough Spring
fusions.desc: You bend a bough and let it fling you up to 7 tiles onto the target, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that from the full distance.

fusions.name: Gall Spatter
fusions.desc: Kicks a cone of hopping gall seeds ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Too Small to Fell
fusions.desc: You hop 2 tiles and set your bark: damage you take is reduced by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Wayfarer's Ward
fusions.desc: Each time you have covered enough ground, your bark closes into a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
